strongest_counterexample: Interpolation of grounded and airborne wrist targets can yield a folded or backward elbow even with exact segment lengths. Likewise seat/root counterrotation can disconnect knees/stirrups and alter neck bridge. Those must fail the actual phase review; no contact metric or healthy rig can override an unnatural visible body.
